content: Consider a set of documents which belong to the same context $D_c = \lbrace d_i\rbrace _{i=1}^{|D_c|}$ . Each document $d_i$ is represented by a set of $N_i$ words, $d_i = \lbrace w_k\rbrace _{k=1}^{N_i}$ . By considering that all words from documents of the same context belong to the same distribution, a set of words $W_c = \lbrace w_k\rbrace _{k=1}^{N_c}$ with the words in the context $c$ is obtained.
